scenarios.name: All slots empty
scenarios.setup: Remove all active assignments; keep roles and slots.

scenarios.name: No roles yet
scenarios.setup: Remove all roles, slots and assignments; keep a valid central project/workspace.

scenarios.name: Main does not imply Shortlist
scenarios.setup: Set assignment_father_omar Main using atomic replacement; keep its shortlisted false. Previous Main becomes Backup.

scenarios.name: Same candidate independent slots
scenarios.setup: Set only assignment_manager_samir shortlisted false and notes changed.

scenarios.name: Direct shortlist assignment
scenarios.setup: Assign candidate_lina to slot_waiter_3 with explicit shortlisted true, default Option.

scenarios.name: Long wording
scenarios.setup: Set candidate_samir skills_experience to a deliberately long supplied paragraph and assignment notes to 1000 characters.

scenarios.name: Frame shortfall
scenarios.setup: Run variants with Omar selected frame counts 2, 1 and 0.

scenarios.name: Unknown headcount
scenarios.setup: Add a role with headcount null and a provisional slot.

scenarios.name: Unreviewed reusable
scenarios.setup: Add candidate_omar to a second accessible project before confirming Reviewed.

scenarios.name: New video preserves old version
scenarios.setup: Generate V1; select replacement Omar media; generate V2.

scenarios.name: Guest scope
scenarios.setup: Create two valid guest links to same client_agency series and a separate internal series.

scenarios.name: Version completion order
scenarios.setup: Queue V2 then V3; complete V3 before V2.

scenarios.name: Duplicate callback
scenarios.setup: Deliver successful scan callback twice with same job attempt/result identity.

scenarios.name: Stale scan result
scenarios.setup: Edit reusable supplied fact after scan starts, before scan callback.

scenarios.name: External PDF authorization
scenarios.setup: Generate link-scoped V1 PDF; open media in fresh browser; disable new PDF downloads; then revoke parent link.

scenarios.name: Extend parent link
scenarios.setup: Create external V1 PDF, then intentionally extend the active parent review link expiry.

scenarios.name: Partial 200-video batch
scenarios.setup: Create 200 distinct upload records; include corrupt, silent and valid synthetic technical files; use bounded concurrency.
